verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a testing guide for Issuing and says you can simulate test purchases before going live. That, combined with the real-time authorization webhook for approving or declining, suggests auth logic can be exercised in a sandbox. However, the evidence never shows simulation of each lifecycle stage the story names. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of simulating clearings/captures, reversals, refunds, and declines in test mode; detail on the test-helper endpoints; independent or hands-on corroboration.
